# ADR-3062: A06: Unpinned transitive import for module set 2

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Floating versions pull breaking or vulnerable releases.

## Decision

Services MUST NOT rely on an unpinned transitive import for module set 2 (A06-2).

## Consequences

Lockfiles are committed and verified in CI.
